mapper.select:
select o.order_no as orderNo, max(o.customer_name) as customerName, round(ifnull(sum(o.amount), 0), 2) as orderAmount, round(ifnull(max(f.finish_weight), 0), 2) as finishWeight, round(ifnull(max(f.material_cost), 0), 2) as materialCost, round(ifnull(max(f.finish_weight), 0) * #{processCost}, 2) as processCost, round(ifnull(sum(o.amount), 0) - ifnull(max(f.material_cost), 0) - ifnull(max(f.finish_weight), 0) * #{processCost}, 2) as profit, round((ifnull(sum(o.amount), 0) - ifnull(max(f.material_cost), 0) - ifnull(max(f.finish_weight), 0) * #{processCost}) / nullif(sum(o.amount), 0) * 100, 2) as profitRate from ord_sale_order o left join ( select fc.order_no, sum(fc.net_weight) as finish_weight, sum(fc.net_weight * ifnull(m.raw_price, 0)) as material_cost from inv_finish_coil fc left join md_material m on m.material_code = fc.material_code group by fc.order_no ) f on f.order_no = o.order_no
and o.order_no like concat('%', #{orderNo}, '%') and o.customer_name like concat('%', #{customerName}, '%')
group by o.order_no order by profit desc
